title: Complex Agony
story: The genesis of the artist's visual inquiry. Created over six months as his first canvas painting, this work features a figure clutching her hands over her heart—a visceral excavation of emotional density, self-preservation, and resilience.

title: Splendid Soul
story: The artist's largest early work; a testament to finding grace, splendor, and internal confidence amidst the chaos of struggle using dramatic, classical chiaroscuro lighting.

title: The Urban Hermit
story: The definitive archetype of the early period. Captures the quiet weight of introspection and a figure seeking retreat from institutional noise to build an authentic inner voice.

title: Nothing on you
story: A haunting, ethereal portrait using muted atmospheric tones to create a sense of lingering, ghostly presence and quiet emotional resonance.

title: Strings Teem Senses
story: An exploration of sensory vibration, translating the physical tuning and rhythm of guitar strings (EADGBe) into visual geometry and emotional flow across multiple panels.

title: Gaol of Greed
story: A heavy, textured commentary on societal entrapment and the psychological burden of being 'jailed' by material and synthetic desires.

title: Trying and Being
story: A high-intensity study of existence, focusing on the visceral reality of physical presence, identity formation, and internal perseverance.

title: Now you see me, now you don't
story: A cool-toned portrait playing with presence and absence; explores the concealed layers of identity we choose to withhold from public view.

title: The Stripped Tint
story: An introspective study of a bowed figure examining moral weight, humility, and the quiet tension of an awakened conscience.

title: The One Who Knew
story: A vibrant, warm-toned portrait carrying the symbolic burden and silent reverence of personal memory.

title: Sneak Peak
story: An initial excavation of the concept of sanctuary—the search for a psychological space where one feels most rooted and authentic.

title: The Doomed One
story: An unflinching look at existential weight; a monochromatic study exploring the raw interplay between human form and fluid paint.

title: Blue Winds
story: A pivotal transition work moving away from strict figuration into dynamic atmospheric abstraction, using sweeping azure strokes to depict movement.

title: Strangers in the night
story: A bridge work moving toward high-intensity emotional abstraction and warm chromatic fields, capturing fleeting urban encounters.

title: Burnt Wine
story: Marks the artist's first major move into mixed media, focusing on surface friction, organic unfolding of dense materials, and earthy textures.

title: Elucidated
story: A shift toward luminosity and optical clarity; cool blue and white glazes signaling clarity of thought and artistic maturity.

title: The Conflict of Love and Chastity
story: Created in Sydney, this work introduces a high-contrast 'glitch' effect across classical portraiture traditions, capturing contemporary friction.

title: Study of Balance
story: A landmark experiment in fluid resin. Designed as a horizontal liquid landscape, meditating on the delicate balance between intentional control and fluid surrender.

title: Querencia
story: A mature resolution of the search for a safe space. Incorporates graphic figuration against a luminous gold-leaf background symbolizing psychological sanctuary.

title: Richie Make Money
story: Marks the pivot where 'The Hermit' steps into 'The Market.' A vibrant, satirical inquiry into wealth accumulation and how modern systems define individual worth.

title: Richie Carrying Gifts & High Fashion Brands
story: A maximalist critique of hyper-consumerism. The iconic pop figure is portrayed physically burdened by modern luxury status symbols, examining the performance of identity in brand culture.
